title: Native loopback POST /v1/local/concat/production/request
description: Header X-Concat-Integration: 1 is required. Numeric 127.0.0.1 only, no redirects, browser Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site rejected. profileId must exist in Nexora on every request. Only artcraft workflow definitions, validate/start, run detail/list/cancel/resume are allowed. Request/response use the existing Promax envelope; HTTP status is preserved. Promax credentials stay native in Nexora. No retries for mutations. This header is not a cloud credential: local native applications share the existing loopback trust boundary. Cloud admission is separate and opt-in.

x-worker-transport.identity: POST /v1/local/concat/production/worker-identity with {profileId}; returns {client_id,device_id,tenant_id,user_id} only, never credentials
x-worker-transport.websocket: GET /v1/local/concat/production/worker?profileId=<id>; same native headers. Nexora authenticates the upstream ArtCraft websocket using its own device session, forces clientType/clientId/deviceId, bounds messages to 1 MiB, and closes both sockets together. Existing Promax envelopes/ACK/results are unchanged.
x-worker-transport.scope: Worker accepts only locally reserved workflow/Page/graph snapshots. Local artifacts never become remote path inputs. Missing capabilities continue to block preflight. No Concat login or cloud-token export is added.
x-worker-transport.infrastructureError: Upstream HTTP 503 with error.code TRANSPORT_ORIGIN_NOT_CONFIGURED is mapped to native HTTP 503 PROMAX_TRANSPORT_NOT_CONFIGURED (retryable false). Other upstream bodies or credentials are never returned. Concat stops its reconnect loop for this deployment error and explains that runtime configuration is required.
